The expense editor is reordered amount-first (large autofocused MoneyInput, description, styled date with a human-reading label from humanDateLabel(date, today) where today is computed client-side once so SSR and hydration never disagree, single-payer default with progressive multi-payer reveal, SegmentedControl split type, per-member rows with Avatar plus a styled include switch preserving split.N.included plus input plus live computed share from splitAmount(), category plus note) with a sticky Save/Cancel bar and blur-aware section notes reusing the server's shortfall sentences; every FormData name stays identical so createExpense/updateExpense accept and refuse exactly as today. Settle-up loses its inline row forms: each transfer row shows who-pays-whom plus amount with a Settle up button (suppressed when archived, plain row as today) opening Dialog variant='sheet' with the suggestion prefilled in an editable MoneyInput and one Record payment confirm; the sheet body is exported for static-markup prefill tests and each open starts with clean refusal state. Payment success joins the ADR-0008 pattern with the remainder problem fixed: createPayment/deletePayment redirect with ?payment=recorded&from=<membershipId>&to=<membershipId>, the group page validates the pair against this group's seats (a non-seat renders nothing, like a forged value), recomputes the directed remainder through computeNetBalances plus simplifyDebts, and renders paymentNoticeText(raw, remainderMinor, currency) in the debts card's own panel-level role=status slot — never a second page-level slot. Over-payment stays accepted by design (no new validation rule): the notice names the flipped or settled remainder honestly. Deletes move behind the shared generic Menu (extracted from account-menu.tsx, which keeps its behavior) plus a Dialog opened directly on the ConfirmStep, preserving the name-the-object convention with focus trap and return. Per-type input text stays a single string per member (reopening fidelity from the unchanged getExpenseEditorData read-back); the IAC-5 optional-date clause is deferred because payments have no date column by spec.
assumptions: Issue #33 (piece 1) is merged with the Dialog, SegmentedControl, MoneyInput, Button, Toast, Avatar, Badge APIs as read in components/ui.tsx and components/ui-interactive.tsx

The repo has no jsdom, so interactive behavior (sheet open, focus trap, sticky bar, double-submit, Escape/Tab/return-focus) is proved by the browser half of qa_script, following the precedent of the existing static-markup tests

work_order.confidence_rationale: Every critique finding was re-verified against the code (payment schema has no suggestion comparison, the included checkbox is the sole emitter of split.N.included, DeleteExpenseForm starts with a Delete button, Dialog closed renders null, both notice validators are raw-param functions, the debts live-region test and the edit-page call site both exist) and each has a decided, evidenced resolution. What keeps this at 72 rather than higher: overlap friction with sibling group-page pieces editing the same page regions, and browser-only proof of focus-trap/Escape/return-focus behavior for a Dialog used in production for the first time.
work_order.debate_summary: The critique was right on all thirteen findings and I verified each against the code rather than taking its word: (1) blocking — AC-6 asserted a remainder sentence no file could compose, fixed by carrying from/to ids in the redirect and recomputing the remainder in the page; (2) the plan missed debts-live-region.test.ts and the edit-page DeleteExpenseForm call site despite claiming all callers grepped, both now in files[]; (3) the redesigned split row dropped split.N.included, which would hard-refuse every save via superRefine — a styled per-row include switch is now required and AC-2 covers leave-out/put-back; (4) the QA over-amount refusal is unproducible since no such rule exists — replaced with real refusals, over-payment accepted by design with an honest flipped-remainder notice; (5) the plan rebuilt account-menu.tsx's menu from scratch — now an extraction with the menu reusing stepMenuItem/menuKeyIntent; (6) AC-5 silently dropped the optional date while citing IAC-5 — now labelled partial with an explicit out_of_scope deferral; (7) S-8 is the spec Experience section, not a ui.md screen reference — assumption corrected; (8) the recordPayment helper churn understated — the whole success-path surface moves to redirectUrl; (9) menu→Delete→dialog→Delete→confirm was five steps — the dialog now opens directly on the confirm step; (10) humanDateLabel needs a clock and would hydration-mismatch across timezones — now humanDateLabel(date, today) with a client-side today; (11) the residual-risk note was wrong and a second page-level role=status slot repeats the shape ADR-0008 rejected — the payment notice now lives in the debts card's panel slot; (12) the rewritten settle-row-identity test could not assert prefill through a closed Dialog — the sheet body is now exported for static markup and the row-key seam retained; (13) Dialog/Toast were never rendered anywhere — a static-contract test is added and Escape/Tab/return-focus are explicitly browser-QA. One scoping judgment of my own: I did not require inert on the dialog background (finding 13's aside) — Tab-trap without inert is left as-is and recorded as a residual risk rather than widening this ticket.

issue_snapshot.title: Expense editor and settle-up sheet with confirms and menus
issue_snapshot.body:
Recording an expense correctly the first time and settling a suggested transfer take seconds, with the amount prominent and destructive choices confirmed.

UI face: payer records an expense amount-first with live per-member shares and a sticky save, and settles up through a prefilled sheet instead of inline row forms, with confirms on destructive choices. Contract face: consumes money inputs, segmented control, dialogs/sheets, toasts, and notice-param success treatment from piece 1; submits through the existing expense and payment Server Actions with identical payloads and validation, defining no new endpoint. Follows docs/ui.md Expense editor and Settle-up flow structures and states exactly.

**Risk.** Touches the two money-writing surfaces (expense amounts with live shares, settle-up prefilled amounts); money math and payloads are unchanged and review must reject any logic change.

**Out of scope**
- Any split-math, remainder-rule, balance, simplification, or transaction change
- Group page sections, members, activity, and profile screens (sibling pieces)
- Dark mode

Covers: TR-11, S-8
Part of #31.
Depends on #33.

## Acceptance (from the split)
- **IAC-1** EXPENSE EDITOR: amount is first, large, autofocused money input with group currency prefix and decimal input mode, followed by description, styled date picker with human reading, and category plus note.
- **IAC-2** EXPENSE EDITOR: payer area defaults to me with a single payer; Paid by several people progressively reveals per-person parts; split-type segmented control (equal, exact, percentage, shares) shows only that type's per-member rows with avatar, name, and live computed share.
- **IAC-3** EXPENSE EDITOR: live sum and remainder line confirms parts equal the total; validation on blur and submit names the shortfall and its size; reopening shows the stored split type and each member input exactly as entered.
- **IAC-4** EXPENSE EDITOR: sticky bottom bar holds primary Save and Cancel with back-to-group; saving disables Save with Saving plus spinner, never unmounts mid-save, double submit is impossible, and failed save keeps all input with retry.
- **IAC-5** SETTLE-UP: per-transfer Settle up opens a centred dialog on desktop and bottom sheet on phones with the who-pays-whom line, suggested amount prefilled and editable for partial payment, optional date, one Record payment confirm plus cancel; no inline amount forms on rows.
- **IAC-6** SETTLE-UP: confirming records the payment and updates feed plus balances with a toast or redirect notice; after a partial payment the confirmation shows what remains owed; failed record keeps the sheet open with all input, names the problem, and offers retry.
- **IAC-7** Deleting a recorded expense or payment confirms in a dialog naming the object and its consequence; destructive pending and focus-trap plus focus-return hold; every control is keyboard reachable with visible focus at 375px and 1280px.
